'''Alonzo''', billed as the '''Amazing Alonzo''', was a creature trainer with [[Kersh Lauskner's Traveling Animal/Acrobatic Arcadium]]. He controlled a trained [[trompa]], and carried an [[electric prod]] in case the creature got out of hand.<ref name="GC" />
